articles.title: How to clean your glasses without scratching them, according to an optician and optometrist
articles.summary: I found the best methods and products for cleaning glasses, including reading glasses, sunglasses and more. Optometrists recommend the best cleaning products.
articles.body: With all the content available online these days, it can be hard to figure out what’s real and what’s hype. While we don’t always have the answers, we have a direct line to people who do — which is why we present to you our series The Internet Made Me Ask, where we have experts break down the truth about some of the buzziest trends (and questions) on our timelines, like whether bath sheets are actually different from towels. If you wear glasses, you know just how annoying smudges can be. In fact, it can be nearly impossible to focus on whatever you’re looking at. Plus, if you use the wrong products to clean eyewear, it can compromise their quality over time, which leads to more costs down the road. To keep your glasses clean without ruining them, it’s best to use cleaners that don’t have “alcohol, harsh chemicals, perfumes and scents,” says Sheena Taff, an optician and business owner at Optician About Town. “The smell is usually a great indicator, lens cleaner shouldn’t have an obvious odor to it.” For a step-by-step tutorial on the best way to clean glasses — and the best products to do it — I asked Taff and other eyewear experts for their guidance, which I share below. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best products for cleaning glasses Before we get to the steps, we want to make sure you have the right products to get your eye glasses, reading glasses, sunglasses and other specs in top shape. Aside from water and mild soap (which works well for this task), there are other easy options to try. Below I’ve listed several highly-rated lens cleaners for you to consider. If you prefer a portable and tech-safe cleaning spray (it also cleans camera lenses without damaging them), consider this option from Koala. The alcohol- and ammonia-free formula is a mix of water- and plant-based ingredients that help eliminate smudges and debris. It also comes with a microfiber cloth so that you don’t resort to using a paper towel that could scratch your lenses. Besides glasses, these square-shaped microfiber cleaning cloths can be used to clean a range of screens, including your phone, television, laptop, camera or tablet. Each one measures a decent 6 x 7 inches, and you can get them in packs of two, six, 13 or 30. These moistened wipes are great for cleaning glasses, especially ones with excessive debris, dust or residue. Each wipe is 5 x 6 inches and, since the-alcohol based solution in the wipes dries extremely fast, they don’t leave streaks on glasses, according to the brand. They come individually wrapped so you can always keep one on you and clean your specs while on the go. This lens-cleaning care pack comes with two 8-ounce bottles of spray and two microfiber cloths that are 6 x 7 inches each. Use it to wipe away fingerprints, dust, oil and more without leaving streaks or scratches on the lenses or frames. Like other options, you can also use it to clean other items with lenses and displays, such as cameras, sunglasses and binoculars. This set has two 4-ounce bottles of cleaning spray and two microfiber cloths that are 6 x 3 inches. You can use them to clean eyeglasses and sunglasses as well as TV screens, cameras, tablets, phones and more. How to clean your glasses, step by step Most glasses cases come with a small microfiber cloth. This is a good place to start when wiping down your lenses. Use that cloth to gently buff out any smudges. However, more stubborn streaks and dirt may require a more in-depth cleaning. For the best method, Taff recommends these steps: Step 1: Use a spray, such as Zeiss Lens Care Pack or Koala Eyeglass Lens Cleaner Spray Kit, to spray and coat the surface of the lenses, and then wipe away any dust or debris with the included cloth. Allow them to dry.Step 2: Alternatively, fill a small bowl with lukewarm water to help remove any gritty particles that could scratch your lenses. Make sure the water isn’t too hot. “Exposure to heat and hot water damages glasses and lenses,” says Taff. Put a tiny drop of dish soap, such as Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray, in the water. Slowly, dip the lenses of the glasses in the water, moving them back and forth in the water, being sure to hold onto the tips of the temples. Step 3: Rinse thoroughly with warm water.Step 4: Dry them off with a clean microfiber cloth. This is key — no paper towels or your shirt, both of which could have a rough texture or dirt particles that will scratch your lenses. How do you know if your glasses need to be cleaned? As obvious as it sounds, you should clean your glasses when they’re dirty or become hard to see through. With that said, glasses can take on varying degrees of dirtiness. Overall, if you notice any smudge or haziness on any part of your lenses, they need a good wipe down. Additionally, it might be worth trying out an ultrasonic cleaner for cleaning your glasses more thoroughly. “Even the cleanest looking glasses release hidden oil and residue once put into an ultrasonic cleaner,” says Taff. What are the best products for cleaning glasses? “The best option is a spray solution that is specifically made for cleaning glasses. This is often available at optical stores or other retail outlets that sell glasses,” says Joy Harewood-John, associate professor of optometry at SUNY College of Optometry. “If that is not available, then regular water can suffice.” Another option is to use a diluted mixture of dish soap and water. Also, a microfiber cloth is always best compared to a paper towel, which can leave small scratches on lenses, according to Taff. These products are always recommended over alcohol-based cleaners, which strip lens coating, according to Harewood-John. articles.title: West of England in pictures: Dairy show and surprise royal visit
articles.summary: A round-up of pictures taken across the West of England this week.
articles.body:
Celebrity Traitors star Ross Kemp joined The Prince of Wales on a royal visit to Ilminster in Somerset, where they launched a new project to help local communities prepare for emergencies and extreme weather.

And some of the finest dairy cattle were judged at the UK's largest dairy show in at the Bath and West Showground in Shepton Mallet on Wednesday.

Here's a round-up of photographs taken across the West this week.

Surprise visit: The award-winning actor and documentary maker Ross Kemp joined Prince William on a surprise royal visit to Ilminster on Tuesday , where they launched a new campaign called Ready Together, which aims to help communities prepare for emergencies and extreme weather.

Royal treat: Schoolchildren and members of the local community were overjoyed to meet the Prince of Wales when he visited on Tuesday.

The show must go on: The Bridgwater Carnival concert series started with a bang this week. The events are taking place at The McMillan Theatre until 15 October.

Legen-dairy: Exhibitors from across Britain showcased some of their finest cattle at the The Dairy Show 2026 on Wednesday. The event is one of the most important dates in the dairy farmer's calendar, combining a comprehensive trade show with an exhibition of top-quality dairy cattle.

New heights: After two and a half years, the Clifton Suspension Bridge Trust has completed the project to refurbish the Clifton Suspension Bridge. The multi-million pound project began in April 2024 and was funded entirely through bridge tolls.

Relight my fire: Bristol Glassworks Ltd officially opened this week. The company was set up by Bristol Blue Glass workers who were made redundant this year - they'll continue making the famous blue glass pieces alongside other modern shapes and colours.

Better together: Partners, supporters, colleagues and friends were welcomed to Bristol's Watershed this week for its 10th anniversary impact event, "Raised In Turns 10: Celebrating Impact Together". It marks a decade of working alongside children, families and communities to create opportunities, strengthen connections and support brighter futures.

Ghost Rainbow: With Halloween only three weeks away, a rare ghost rainbow [or fogbow] was captured by WeatherWatcher nigedvd in Tollard Royal near Shaftesbury on Tuesday.

The phenomena occurs when the water droplets in fog cause the colours to overlap, resulting in a white rainbow.

Autumn walks: Dog walkers across the country have been dodging the showers this week, but the autumnal conditions seem not to have affected the enthusiasm of their four-legged friends.

Thanks to WeatherWatcher CraigRich for taking this picture of George on his morning walk in Winterslow.

Military bond: A stained-glass window has been unveiled at St Michael's Church in Lyneham to honour the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers (REME), an Army corps based at MoD Lyneham.

Colonel Tim Gillies said: "I think the window is more than artwork; it's a lasting tribute to over 80 years of REME service."

Almost ready: Pumpkin farmers are keeping a close eye on their crops in the build up to Halloween. In the next couple of weeks, the festive squash will gradually change colour from green to orange, including this impressive specimen from Upavon near Pewsey.

Top team: Swindon's Health Visiting Team were recently nominated for Health Visitor Team of the Year 2026 at the Institute of Health Visiting Practice Awards. The team provides support to families during some of the most important early years of a child's life.

Hitting the jackpot: Members of Longlevens AFC have been celebrating after their whopping £1m National Lottery win in the Lotto draw.

Flying away: Earlier this week, president Donald Trump removed a number of US bombers from RAF Fairford because of "threats to the base."

Red sky at night: This beautiful pink sunset lit up the skies above the Cotswold village of Poulton on Tuesday evening as the nights draw in.

Mooving into autumn: These cows shared a moment in the autumn sunshine against the stunning backdrop of the Severn Vale on Thursday morning.

Just the ticket: A bus shelter built to celebrate the Festival of Britain in 1952 has been listed by the government. The shelter in Hillesley, Gloucestershire, was designed by leading modernist architect Berthold Lubetkin.

articles.title: Flórida executa detento que matou colega para ser condenado à morte | G1
articles.standfirst: James Robertson, de 63 anos, foi executado quase 18 anos após o crime. Ele abriu mão dos recursos judiciais e disse que matou o colega para não passar o resto da vida na prisão.
articles.summary: James Robertson, de 63 anos, foi executado na Flórida quase 18 anos após matar o colega de cela. Ele afirmou que cometeu o crime para não passar o resto da vida na prisão.
articles.body:
O presidiário James Robertson, de 63 anos, foi executado nesta terça-feira (13) na Flórida, nos Estados Unidos . Ele havia matado um colega de cela em 2008, com o objetivo de ser condenado à morte e evitar passar o resto da vida na prisão.

Robertson recebeu uma injeção letal com três medicamentos e morreu cerca de dez minutos depois.

Robertson acordou às 5h45 desta terça-feira (13). Segundo as autoridades, sua última refeição incluiu bife, batatas, ovos fritos, torradas e leite. Ele recebeu duas visitas, de um primo e de um amigo por correspondência, e não se encontrou nenhum líder religioso.

Questionado se gostaria de dizer algo antes da execução, Robertson respondeu: "Não. Sou hétero".

Foi a primeira execução na Flórida desde que uma tentativa de executar Christa Pike, no Tennessee, fracassou há duas semanas . Ela sobreviveu a duas doses de um medicamento letal e precisou ser levada às pressas para o hospital.

O caso ocorre em meio ao aumento da atenção sobre a pena de morte nos Estados Unidos. Na semana passada, o Pentágono anunciou que transmitiria ao vivo a execução por fuzilamento de Nidal Malik Hasan , responsável por um ataque a tiros na base militar de Fort Hood . A decisão foi criticada por parlamentares republicanos e democratas.

Robertson se declarou culpado de homicídio em primeiro grau por estrangular Frank Hart enquanto ele dormia, em 2008 — Foto: Foto: Departamento Penitenciário da Flórida

Robertson se declarou culpado de homicídio em primeiro grau por estrangular Frank Hart enquanto ele dormia, em 2008. Ele abriu mão de todos os recursos judiciais e disse aos investigadores que matou o colega para evitar passar o resto da vida na cadeia.

Hart estava a apenas oito dias de ser libertado quando foi morto, segundo sua filha, Rebecca Hart.

Robertson foi preso aos 17 anos, em 1980, por invasão de domicílio e agressão. Depois, condenações por fuga, agressão e porte de armas dentro da prisão aumentaram sua pena. Hart também cumpria pena desde 2003, após ser condenado por um crime sexual.

Robertson teria sido o segundo presidário executado pela Flórida nesta terça. Na semana passada, porém, o governador Ron DeSantis revogou o mandado de execução de William Lee Thompson, de 74 anos. O republicano não explicou a decisão, mas havia suspendido temporariamente a execução no mês anterior para aguardar uma avaliação psiquiátrica.

Foi a primeira vez que DeSantis revogou um mandado de execução. Thompson continuará no corredor da morte, e uma nova data poderá ser marcada. Seus advogados afirmam que ele tem demência e está com a saúde debilitada. Eles pedem que seja transferido para uma unidade médica.

Thompson foi condenado por homicídio em primeiro grau, sequestro e violência sexual pelo assassinato de Sally Ivester, de 23 anos, em 1976. Outros dois governadores da Flórida já haviam marcado sua execução na década de 1980, mas recursos judiciais e suspensões impediram que a sentença fosse cumprida.

DeSantis supervisionou 19 execuções em 2025 , o maior número em um único ano por um governador da Flórida desde a retomada da pena de morte, em 1976. Robertson foi a 17ª pessoa executada no estado em 2026 . Outras duas execuções estão marcadas, uma para 20 de outubro e outra para 5 de novembro .

Os Estados Unidos executaram 47 pessoas em 2025. Neste ano, a Flórida responde por mais da metade das 31 execuções registradas no país até agora. Em julho, o estado executou dois detentos no mesmo dia, algo que não acontecia em um estado americano havia quase dez anos.

articles.title: Meningite em Sete Barras: aulas são retomadas após caso em escola | G1
articles.standfirst: Atividades da Escola Municipal de Educação Infantil (EMEI) Vereador Albertino de Souza, em Sete Barras (SP), foram retomadas nesta terça-feira (13), após a adoção das medidas sanitárias recomendadas.
articles.summary: Meningite em Sete Barras: aulas na EMEI Albertino de Souza foram retomadas nesta terça-feira após desinfecção e medicação preventiva de alunos da rede municipal.
articles.body:
Uma professora foi diagnosticada com meningite em Sete Barras , no interior de São Paulo. As aulas da escola onde a profissional trabalha foram retomadas nesta terça-feira (13) após uma suspensão preventiva de dois dias.

De acordo com a Prefeitura de Sete Barras, a profissional é professora do Pré II D da Escola Municipal de Educação Infantil (EMEI) Vereador Albertino de Souza. Os 20 alunos da turma receberam medicação preventiva com o objetivo de reduzir o risco de transmissão e prevenir novos casos da doença.

Ainda segundo a prefeitura, a professora é o único caso confirmado de meningite na cidade. Os detalhes sobre o estado de saúde dela não foram divulgados até a última atualização desta reportagem.

Aulas foram suspensas após professora ser diagnosticada com meningite em Sete Barras, SP — Foto: Reprodução/Facebook e CDC

A prefeitura informou que as secretarias de Educação e de Saúde atuaram de forma integrada desde a confirmação do caso. Entre as providências, as aulas da unidade de ensino foram suspensas na quinta (8) e sexta-feira (9), e uma desinfecção foi realizada na sala usada pela professora.

Após a adoção das medidas sanitárias recomendadas, as atividades da escola foram retomadas nesta terça-feira (13). A administração da cidade destacou que a situação continua sendo acompanhada pelas equipes responsáveis.

"A prefeitura reforça que todas as providências foram tomadas com prioridade à saúde e à segurança dos alunos, professores e demais profissionais da comunidade escolar", finalizou a administração municipal, por meio de nota.

articles.title: Papa Leão XIV com câncer de pulmão: veja comunicado do Vaticano  | G1
articles.standfirst: Após o fim da cirurgia, Vaticano divulgou o boletim médico do pontífice.
articles.summary: Após o fim da cirurgia, Vaticano divulgou o boletim médico do pontífice.
articles.body:
O papa Leão XIV foi diagnosticado com adenocarcinoma pulmonar , um tipo de câncer no pulmão , após a retirada de um nódulo removido durante uma cirurgia nesta terça-feira (13), informou o Vaticano . O comunicado informa que exames pré-operatórios já indicavam a suspeita da doença.

“O Dr. Luigi Carbone e o Prof. Stefano Margaritora comunicam o seguinte a respeito da intervenção realizada nesta tarde:

O Santo Padre foi submetido, conforme programado, a uma cirurgia torácica.

Para assegurar a radicalidade da intervenção, foi removido o lobo inferior do pulmão direito por meio de técnica videoassistida. O exame histológico intraoperatório confirmou o diagnóstico de adenocarcinoma pulmonar, conforme suspeitado pelos exames pré-operatórios.

O Santo Padre permaneceu na sala de cirurgia por cerca de três horas, enquanto a intervenção teve duração aproximada de 90 minutos. A cirurgia foi bem-sucedida e não houve complicações.

Após a intervenção, o Papa despertou normalmente e, depois de um breve período de observação, retornou ao seu quarto, no 10º andar.

A equipe cirúrgica foi coordenada pelo Prof. Stefano Margaritora, auxiliado pela Prof.ª Elisa Meacci, pela Dr.ª Maria Teresa Congedo e pelo Dr. Leonardo Petracca Caravella.

A equipe de anestesiologia era composta pelo Prof. Massimo Antonelli, pelo Dr. Giovanni Punzo e pelo Dr. Giuseppe Bello.”

Segundo a agência de notícias Associated Press, médicos tiveram de aplicar uma anestesia geral e realizaram uma biópsia na lesão após a remoção.

A AP afirmou que cirurgia teve início após profissionais de saúde rezarem o terço na capela do hospital.

“Vamos nos unir em oração, pedindo ao Senhor que ampare nosso bispo, o papa Leão, e conforte todos aqueles que estão hospitalizados aqui”, disse o vigário de Roma , cardeal Baldassare Reina, durante a oração, segundo fontes da AP.

A cirurgia estava prevista para iniciar às 11h no horário de Brasília, porém o pontífice chegou ao hospital Gemelli cerca de 1h após o horário inicialmente previsto, o que acabou atrasando o início do procedimento.

O procedimento, revelado no fim de semana pelo próprio papa, foi recomendado após médicos detectarem uma lesão em seu pulmão. O anúncio surpreendeu fiéis durante oração na Praça de São Pedro.

O pontífice, de 71 anos, não tem nenhum outro problema de saúde conhecido.

articles.title: Motociclista tenta fugir de abordagem e é preso em Volta Redonda | G1
articles.standfirst: Homem pilotava sem capacete e estava com o licenciamento da moto vencido desde 2017.
articles.summary: Motociclista preso em Volta Redonda pilotava sem capacete e com licenciamento vencido desde 2017, resultando em quase R$ 4 mil em multas após tentativa de fuga.
articles.body:
Motociclista sem CNH tenta fugir de abordagem e é preso em Volta Redonda. — Foto: Divulgação/Semop

Um motociclista foi preso em flagrante após tentar fugir de uma abordagem da Guarda Municipal na segunda-feira (12), em Volta Redonda (RJ). O caso aconteceu no Elevado Castelo Branco, no bairro Ponte Alta.

Segundo a Guarda Municipal, os agentes encontraram um grupo de motociclistas participando de um “rolezinho”, com condutores sem capacete e veículos sem placa. Ao receber ordem de parada, o grupo tentou fugir.

Um dos motociclistas, que estava sem capacete, foi interceptado após fugir de forma imprudente, colocando em risco a própria segurança e a de outros motoristas. Durante a fiscalização, os agentes constataram que ele não tinha Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) e que o licenciamento da motocicleta estava vencido desde 2017.

O homem foi levado para a delegacia de Volta Redonda, onde o caso foi registrado. Ele foi autuado em flagrante por desobediência e por dirigir sem habilitação.

A ocorrência resultou na emissão de dez autos de infração, que somam R$ 3.885 em multas. A motocicleta foi removida para o depósito público da Guarda Municipal.

articles.title: Carreta do Agora Tem Especialistas realiza mais de 2 mil exames em Sumaré | G1
articles.standfirst: Unidade móvel do Ministério da Saúde realizou 1.432 tomografias e 663 ultrassonografias durante um mês de atendimento no Ambulatório de Especialidades
articles.summary: Unidade móvel do Ministério da Saúde realizou 1.432 tomografias e 663 ultrassonografias durante um mês de atendimento no Ambulatório de Especialidades
articles.body:
Carreta do Agora Tem Especialistas realiza mais de 2 mil exames em Sumaré – Crédito: Divulgação.

A Unidade Móvel do Programa Agora Tem Especialistas, do Ministério da Saúde, em parceria com a AgSUS (Agência Brasileira de Apoio à Gestão do SUS), encerrou na última sexta-feira (2) os atendimentos em Sumaré. Entre 4 de setembro e 2 de outubro, a carreta realizou 2.095 exames de imagem, sendo 1.432 tomografias e 663 ultrassonografias.

A estrutura foi instalada no Ambulatório de Especialidades e integrou as ações do Programa Mais Acesso à Saúde, da Prefeitura de Sumaré. A iniciativa ampliou a oferta de exames de diagnóstico por imagem e contribuiu para reduzir o tempo de espera dos pacientes da rede municipal.

Os atendimentos foram destinados a pacientes que já aguardavam pelos exames e passaram pelo processo de regulação da rede municipal. A Central de Regulação da Secretaria Municipal de Saúde realizou o contato com os pacientes conforme os critérios estabelecidos e a ordem de atendimento.

Além de atender moradores de Sumaré, a unidade móvel também funcionou como referência para municípios da região, com o objetivo de fortalecer a integração entre as redes de saúde e ampliar a regionalização dos serviços.

Para o secretário municipal de Saúde, Frederico Almeida, a ação representa um avanço importante na assistência aos pacientes que aguardavam por exames. “Mais do que números, esses exames representam respostas para pessoas que precisavam de um diagnóstico para dar continuidade ao tratamento. Vamos continuar buscando parcerias e ampliando os serviços para atender a população com mais rapidez e qualidade”, destacou.

A Secretaria Municipal de Saúde iniciou uma nova etapa do Programa Mais Acesso à Saúde, com ampliação da oferta de consultas com especialistas, exames e cirurgias. A iniciativa prevê cerca de 35 mil procedimentos, com foco na redução das filas de espera, no atendimento das demandas acumuladas e na ampliação do acesso aos serviços de saúde.

Entre as ações previstas estão consultas em especialidades como oftalmologia e cirurgia vascular, além de exames como tomografias, ressonâncias magnéticas, endoscopias, colonoscopias e exames cardiológicos.

Na área de cirurgias, o programa também prevê a ampliação dos procedimentos, com destaque para as cirurgias de catarata e de vesícula. As ações têm como objetivo proporcionar diagnóstico, tratamento e recuperação com mais agilidade, além de melhorar a qualidade de vida dos pacientes.

O Mais Acesso à Saúde representa um dos principais projetos da Prefeitura para reduzir o tempo de espera por consultas, exames e procedimentos. Com aproximadamente 35 mil atendimentos previstos nesta nova etapa, o programa busca ampliar a oferta de serviços e proporcionar uma resposta mais rápida às necessidades dos pacientes que aguardam atendimento na rede municipal.

articles.title: Eduardo Leite afirma que manterá neutralidade no 2º turno da eleição | G1
articles.standfirst: Governador do Rio Grande do Sul afirmou que não atuará como liderança política no 2º turno pois tem 'divergências' com as candidaturas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro.
articles.summary: Governador do Rio Grande do Sul afirmou que não atuará como liderança política no 2º turno pois tem 'divergências' com as candidaturas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro.
articles.body:
Eduardo Leite — Foto: Mauricio Tonetto/Palácio Piratini

Governador do Rio Grande do Sul, Eduardo Leite ( PSD ) não revelou em quem votará no 2º turno da eleição presidencial e, em coletiva nesta terça-feira (13), afirmou que manterá posição de neutralidade na disputa entre Lula ( PT ) e Flávio Bolsonaro ( PL ).

“Continuo nessa posição que é não externar a minha posição”, declarou o gaúcho.

🏛️ Leite fez a declaração durante coletiva de imprensa ao lado do governador eleito do Rio Grande do Sul, Luciano Zucco (PL), realizada para tratar sobre a transição de governos no Palácio Piratini, após o resultado da eleição gaúcha.

Leite confirmou ainda que, além de não revelar o que vai digitar na urna eletrônica em 25 de outubro, também não participará da eleição como uma “liderança política” .

“Torço pelo melhor, mas eu vou exercer meu papel como eleitor e não como liderança política.”

No 1º turno, Leite apoiou a candidatura de Ronaldo Caiado , após decisão do diretório nacional do PSD de Gilberto Kassab . Inicialmente, o gaúcho tentou ser o candidato à Presidência do partido , principalmente após a desistência do governador do Paraná, Ratinho Júnior .

Ele então passou a ser cabo eleitoral de Caiado no Rio Grande do Sul e, nas eleições estaduais, buscou na figura do vice-governador Gabriel Souza ( MDB ) eleger um sucessor. Gabriel ficou em terceiro, com 8,43% dos votos válidos .

“No primeiro semestre, busquei, inclusive, me apresentar como um candidato a presidente. Meu partido fez uma outra escolha, e defendi a escolha do meu partido. Agora, no 2º turno, os brasileiros levaram duas propostas com as quais eu tenho as minhas diferenças, as minhas divergências”, completou.

articles.title: Prefeitura de Caraguatatuba capacita 2,6 mil servidores em primeiros socorros | G1
articles.standfirst: Treinamento envolveu profissionais das 64 unidades escolares do município, com orientações sobre procedimentos de emergência, conforme determina a Lei Lucas.
articles.summary: Treinamento envolveu profissionais das 64 unidades escolares do município, com orientações sobre procedimentos de emergência, conforme determina a Lei Lucas.
articles.body:
A Secretaria de Educação de Caraguatatuba promoveu o curso de Primeiros Socorros para 2.600 servidores da rede de ensino, entre professores, auxiliares de desenvolvimento infantil, agentes de apoio escolar, inspetores de aluno e gestores das 64 unidades escolares do município, entre julho de 2025 e outubro de 2026.

Pref Caraguatatuba — Foto: Lucas Katumata/PMC

O treinamento é uma exigência da Lei Federal nº 13.722/2018, a “Lei Lucas”, que tornou obrigatória a capacitação em noções básicas de primeiros socorros de professores e funcionários de estabelecimentos de ensino públicos e privados de educação básica e de estabelecimentos de recreação infantil.

O ciclo terminou na última quarta-feira (8/10), com o treinamento de mais um grupo de professores e outros profissionais de educação, na Emef Prof. Ricardo Luques Sammarco Serra, na Praia das Palmeiras.

Pref. Caraguatatuba — Foto: Lucas Katumata/PMC

O cabo PM do Corpo de Bombeiros de Caraguatatuba, Sérgio da Silva Costa, explicou aos profissionais de educação a correta realização da manobra e massagem de desengasgo em bebês, crianças, jovens, adultos e idosos; e reanimação cardiopulmonar (RCP), enfatizando a importância de chamar as equipes de resgate pelos telefones 192 (SAMU) e 193 (Corpo de Bombeiros) durante a realização dos procedimentos nas vítimas.

“O curso contou com quatro horas/aulas práticas, além de 16 horas/aula on-line, com o conteúdo acessado pelo site do Corpo de Bombeiros do Estado de São Paulo. Por mais difícil que seja a situação, mantenha a calma e siga as instruções do atendente de emergência! Você é o elo entre a vida e morte de uma pessoa”, destacou o cabo PM do Corpo de Bombeiros, Sérgio da Silva Costa.

A Lei Lucas (Lei Federal nº 13.722/18) recebeu este nome em homenagem ao pequeno Lucas Begalli Zamora. Em 2017, o menino de 10 anos faleceu durante um passeio escolar por asfixia mecânica (engasgo). Na ocasião, não havia ninguém preparado para executar as manobras de primeiros socorros que poderiam ter salvado a de Lucas.

A mãe do garoto, Alessandra Begalli, passou a lutar pela capacitação dos profissionais que trabalham com crianças em noções básicas de primeiros socorros. O empenho de Alessandra nas redes sociais ganhou visibilidade nacional e culminou com a sanção da Lei Federal nº 13.722 em 4 de outubro de 2018.

articles.title: Gincana Consciência Limpa arrecada 46 mil recicláveis em Porto Velho | G1
articles.standfirst: Ação da Fundação Rede Amazônica reuniu 430 alunos de escolas municipais; estudantes com maior arrecadação serão premiados nesta quarta-feira (14).
articles.summary: A Gincana Consciência Limpa mobilizou 430 alunos em Porto Velho para promover a educação ambiental e premiar os maiores arrecadadores nesta quarta-feira (14).
articles.body:
Gincana Consciência Limpa arrecada 46 mil recicláveis em Porto Velho — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

Mais de 46 mil embalagens que poderiam acabar no lixo ganharam a oportunidade de voltar à cadeia de reciclagem. Esse foi o resultado da Gincana Consciência Limpa, realizada pela Fundação Rede Amazônica (FRAM) em Porto Velho , que arrecadou 46.045 materiais recicláveis entre 28 de setembro e 9 de outubro. A ação reuniu 35.155 garrafas PET e 10.890 latinhas, com a participação de 430 alunos de escolas municipais.

Mais do que uma disputa entre estudantes, a iniciativa chama a atenção para um desafio presente no dia a dia das cidades: o que fazer com as embalagens depois do consumo. Quando descartados de forma inadequada, esses materiais podem se acumular nas ruas e contribuir para a obstrução de bueiros e sistemas de drenagem. Quando separados corretamente, podem ser encaminhados à reciclagem e utilizados como matéria-prima para novos produtos.

A reciclagem também ajuda a economizar recursos naturais e energia, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa. Segundo a Associação Brasileira do Alumínio (ABAL), a reciclagem do alumínio consome cerca de 95% menos energia e reduz as emissões de gases de efeito estufa na mesma proporção, em comparação com a produção do metal primário. Isso significa que dar uma nova destinação às latinhas contribui para diminuir os impactos ambientais da produção desse material.

Gincana Consciência Limpa arrecada 46 mil recicláveis em RO — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

Após a arrecadação nas escolas, os materiais foram encaminhados à Cooperativa Cata Norte, onde passam por diferentes etapas antes de chegar às indústrias. No local, os resíduos são separados por tipo e, no caso das garrafas PET, também por cor. Em seguida, as embalagens são prensadas em blocos para facilitar o armazenamento e o transporte.

“O que começou na escola começa a ganhar uma outra vida. Depois da separação, os materiais são prensados, pesados e armazenados para serem transportados às indústrias, onde poderão ser transformados em novos produtos. É assim que a gente mostra aos alunos que a destinação correta dos resíduos faz diferença tanto para o meio ambiente quanto para as pessoas que trabalham com a reciclagem”, explicou Dênis Carvalho, especialista em Projetos da Fundação Rede Amazônica.

O trabalho também tem impacto social, ao contribuir para a atividade dos catadores que atuam na coleta, separação e preparação dos resíduos para a reciclagem.

“A Fundação Rede Amazônica vem desenvolvendo esse papel de conscientizar, educar, fazer isso com as crianças, que é o que leva ao retorno e consegue educar certo tipo de gerações culturais na classificação e na destinação correta dos resíduos, além de ajudar na parte social e ambiental”, afirmou Toni dos Santos, representante da Cooperativa Cata Norte.

A gincana envolveu alunos da EMEIEF Areal da Floresta, localizada na Zona Urbana de Porto Velho; da EMEIEF Rio Madeira, também na Zona Urbana; e da EMEF Estela de Araújo Compasso, na Zona Leste da capital.

A escola com maior arrecadação foi a EMEIEF Areal da Floresta, com 21.400 unidades. Em seguida, ficou a EMEIEF Rio Madeira, com 16.105 materiais. Já a EMEF Estela de Araújo Compasso arrecadou 8.540 unidades. Durante a ação, os estudantes levaram materiais de casa para as escolas, envolvendo também as famílias na separação dos resíduos.

Alunos com maior arrecadação serão premiados nesta quarta-feira (14)

A cerimônia de premiação da Gincana Consciência Limpa será realizada nesta quarta-feira (14), das 14h às 17h, no Teatro Banzeiros, em Porto Velho. Os três alunos com maior arrecadação receberão prêmios: um tablet para o primeiro colocado, um headphone para o segundo e uma bolsa para o terceiro. A turma com melhor desempenho coletivo também será reconhecida com o título de “Turma Consciência Limpa”.

O Consciência Limpa é um projeto de educação ambiental, sustentabilidade e cidadania realizado pela Fundação Rede Amazônica (FRAM). A iniciativa promove ações para incentivar o descarte correto de resíduos, a adoção de práticas sustentáveis e a responsabilidade coletiva. Em Porto Velho, a gincana contou com o apoio da Cidade de Porto Velho, da Rioterra e da Eucatur.

articles.title: Atriz brasileira presa pelo ICE em aeroporto recebe autorização para deixar EUA voluntariamente, diz família | G1
articles.standfirst: Renata Alves Mietto, de 26 anos, foi detida pelas autoridades dos EUA no fim de agosto, quando tentava embarcar para o Havaí. Advogados apresentaram pedido de saída voluntária após mãe denunciar maus tratos na prisão.
articles.summary: Renata Alves Mietto, de 26 anos, foi detida pelas autoridades dos EUA no fim de agosto, quando tentava embarcar para o Havaí. Advogados apresentaram pedido de saída voluntária após mãe denunciar maus tratos na prisão.
articles.body:
A atriz brasileira Renata Alves Mietto — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

A atriz brasileira Renata Mietto, presa há quase dois meses pelo ICE, dos Estados Unidos, recebeu autorização da Justiça norte-americana para deixar o país de forma voluntária, segundo disse a mãe da atriz, a corretora Márcia dos Reis, ao g1 .

Mietto, que vive os Estados Unidos, foi presa na sala de embarque do aeroporto de Los Angeles ao tentar embarcar em um voo para o Havaí. A atriz, de 26 anos, cursa universidade no país, mas seu visto estava irregular por uma falha na renovação, de acordo com a família.

Os advogados haviam solicitado o pedido de saída voluntária do país após a Justiça negar a liberdade condicional da atriz. Desta vez, a Justiça acatou o pedido da defesa.

"O juiz foi bem bacana. Disse a ela que ela precisa tomar cuidado ao sair do voo, para pegar o documento provando a saída voluntária, e deu várias cópias da decisão", disse a mãe de Renata ao g1.

👉 A saída voluntária é um procedimento no qual imigrantes em processo de deportação ou detidos pelo ICE podem se oferecer para deixar os Estados Unidos de forma voluntária e se compromete a não retornar aos EUA por um período estipulado pela Justiça.

A corretora contou que filha havia perdido muito peso na prisão e, durante todo o tempo em que ficou detida, não quis que a mãe a visse. "Ela disse que a comida era intragável, impossível de comer", contou a mãe da atriz.

Ainda não há data marcada para que a atriz deixe os EUA. Mas ela deve ir a São Paulo para reocmeçar a vida, segundo Márcia dos Santos.

"Ela não tem nada no Brasil, vai ter que começar tudo do zero", disse .

Renata Mietto foi detida no aeroporto de Los Angeles no dia 27 de agosto, quando se preparava para embarcar para o Havaí. Ela foi presa no portão de embarque por agentes disfarçados do ICE, o Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA que foi designado por Donald Trump para caçar e prender imigrantes em situação irregular.

Renata chegou aos Estados Unidos em 2016, aos 16 anos, munida de um visto de estudante e inscrita em um colégio. Ao terminar o Ensino Médio, ela ingressou na Univesidade de Utah Valley, onde cursava Artes Cênicas. Depois, se mudou para Los Angeles para seguir a carreira de atriz.

Ao tentar transferir o curso para uma universidade na Califórnia, no entanto, a brasileira foi informada de que seu visto estava irregular. De acordo com a mãe, ela procurou advogados que a informaram que não era necessária a renovação.

articles.title: Ação oferece consultas oftalmológicas e óculos gratuitos para crianças | G1
articles.standfirst: Projeto oferece atendimento oftalmológico gratuito e pretende alcançar 600 crianças em situação de vulnerabilidade social durante a semana do Dia das Crianças.
articles.summary: Projeto oferece atendimento oftalmológico gratuito e pretende alcançar 600 crianças em situação de vulnerabilidade social durante a semana do Dia das Crianças.
articles.body:
Ação oferece consultas oftalmológicas e óculos gratuitos para crianças no interior do Piauí até sexta (17) — Foto: Reprodução

Cerca de 600 crianças em situação de vulnerabilidade social devem ser beneficiadas pela ação "Criança de Visão", realizada em Betânia do Piauí , no Sul do estado. A iniciativa segue até sábado (17) e prevê a doação gratuita de aproximadamente 200 óculos para crianças que precisam de correção visual.

Realizada em alusão ao Dia das Crianças, a ação oferece avaliações oftalmológicas gratuitas. As crianças que precisarem poderão receber os óculos sem custo.

O atendimento é realizado por oftalmologistas e optometristas parceiros do Instituto Visão Solidária (IVS), que participam voluntariamente do projeto. A iniciativa é voltada a crianças de famílias de baixa renda que não têm condições de pagar por consultas e óculos.

A mobilização em Betânia do Piauí integra uma campanha nacional do IVS realizada durante o mês de outubro em unidades da rede espalhadas por diferentes regiões do país. Em todo o Brasil, a expectativa é atender mais de 10 mil crianças e distribuir cerca de 2 mil óculos.

articles.title: Acervo de Roberto Müller é levado para cidade natal no PI | G1
articles.standfirst: Guardado em Recife, onde o artista viveu por cerca de 30 anos, o acervo reúne fotos, discos, premiações e objetos pessoais e deverá integrar um museu do município.
articles.summary: Guardado em Recife, onde o artista viveu por cerca de 30 anos, o acervo reúne fotos, discos, premiações e objetos pessoais e deverá integrar um museu do município.
articles.body:
Acervo de Roberto Müller é levado para Piracuruca após desejo do cantor — Foto: Reprodução/ Redes Sociais

Fotos, prêmios e outros objetos que pertenceram ao cantor Roberto Müller foram levados para Piracuruca , cidade natal do artista, no Norte do Piauí. O acervo estava no apartamento dele, em Recife (PE), cidade onde morou por cerca de 30 anos.

O artista morreu em setembro deste ano , após passar um período internado para tratar uma pneumonia.

De acordo com a compositora e empresária Dagmar Pereira, a transferência do acervo para Piracuruca era um desejo manifestado pelo cantor ainda em vida.

"Ele pedia direto: 'por favor, quando eu partir, leve meu acervo pra Piracuruca, não deixe em outro lugar", contou a empresária.

Segundo a Prefeitura de Piracuruca, o acervo passará por um processo de catalogação e deverá integrar um espaço do museu que está em fase de implantação no município.

O acervo reúne fotos, discos, faixas, quadros, revistas, recortes de jornais com entrevistas do cantor e registros ao lado de personalidades brasileiras, como Belchior, Chacrinha e Patrícia Pilar.

Após a morte do artista, o acervo ficou sob os cuidados de Dagmar Pereira. Ela descreveu Roberto Müller como uma pessoa generosa e relembrou os 35 anos de convivência e trabalho ao lado do cantor.

"Ele disse: 'a partir de hoje você vai trabalhar com o Pingo de Ouro, seu ídolo'. Minha família é fã dele, eu tinha quinze anos quando escutei a música dele", relembrou.

Nascido em Piracuruca (PI) no ano de 1937, José Ribamar da Silva iniciou a carreira artística na década de 50, adotou o nome artístico Roberto Müller e ficou conhecido como “o romântico Pingo de Ouro do Brasil”.

Entre os hits, estão as baladas românticas “Entre espumas”, “Sofro por ti” e “Nunca mais brigarei contigo”.

articles.title: Objetos usados pelo Papa João Paulo II em Cuiabá são expostos em MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Exposição segue até sexta-feira (16), das 15h às 18h, e faz parte das comemorações pelos 35 anos da visita do Papa à capital; programação inclui missa e inauguração de estátua.
articles.summary: Exposição segue até sexta-feira (16), das 15h às 18h, e faz parte das comemorações pelos 35 anos da visita do Papa à capital; programação inclui missa e inauguração de estátua.
articles.body:
Objetos utilizados por São João Paulo II durante a visita a Cuiabá, em outubro de 1991, estão expostos no Santuário São João Paulo II. — Foto: Arquidiocese de Cuiabá

Objetos utilizados por São João Paulo II durante a visita a Cuiabá , em outubro de 1991, estão expostos no Santuário São João Paulo II, no bairro Morada do Ouro, na capital. A visitação começou nesta terça-feira (13) e segue até sexta-feira (16), das 15h às 18h.

Entre as peças estão uma casula, veste usada pelo Papa, uma cátedra, cadeira utilizada por um bispo, uma patena e um cálice. Segundo Simone, assessora da Arquidiocese de Cuiabá, os objetos foram preservados pela Igreja após a celebração e têm registros fotográficos que documentam sua utilização.

As peças fazem parte do acervo do Museu de Arte Sacra de Mato Grosso, que está fechado ao público. Segundo a assessora, o acervo permanece preservado e guardado. A exposição foi organizada a partir de uma iniciativa do reitor do Santuário, padre Marcos Ferrucci, que solicitou o empréstimo dos objetos para as comemorações dos 35 anos da visita do Papa à capital.

O Santuário também abriga uma relíquia de primeiro grau de São João Paulo II, formada por uma pequena porção de sangue preservada em um fragmento de tecido de uma roupa do pontífice. De acordo com Simone, a relíquia foi disponibilizada pela Igreja para a veneração dos fiéis.

A assessora também relatou uma lembrança envolvendo o bispo emérito Dom Milton. Segundo ela, quando os dois se encontraram em Roma, antes da morte do Papa, o bispo contou que era de Cuiabá, em Mato Grosso. João Paulo II teria associado a cidade ao calor.

A Arquidiocese também tem fotografias da visita de 1991 e registros de pessoas que participaram da celebração. Segundo Simone, cerca de 100 pessoas foram escolhidas na ocasião para receber a comunhão das mãos do Papa. Algumas já morreram, mas outras foram localizadas e devem participar das comemorações no Santuário.

Além da exposição durante a semana, as atividades em comemoração aos 35 anos da visita de São João Paulo II começam às 18h de sexta-feira, com o Cenáculo, momento de oração realizado com o Movimento Sacerdotal Mariano, seguido da oração do Santo Terço.

Às 19h, será celebrada uma Santa Missa no Santuário. Depois, haverá a inauguração de uma imagem de São João Paulo II em tamanho real, descrita pela Arquidiocese como uma imagem memorial.

A programação termina com apresentações musicais. Às 21h, a cantora católica Celina Borges fará um show gratuito, com participação da banda cuiabana Vozes ao Alto.

articles.title: US Immigration authority has 10-day deadline on home addresses; says: You may not receive your immigration documents if ...
articles.summary: US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has reminded immigrants and visa holders in the United States that they must report a change of address
articles.body: US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has reminded immigrants and visa holders in the United States that they must report a change of address within 10 days of moving, warning that failure to do so could result in missed immigration notices and documents. As per the agency, anyone with a pending immigration benefit request should notify USCIS of an address change as soon as possible to ensure they continue receiving correspondence and benefits without delays. The requirement applies to most foreign nationals in the United States, although A and G visa holders and visa waiver visitors are exempt.USCIS warns of missed immigration documentsUSCIS also clarified that changing the address within the United States Postal Service (USPS) only is not sufficient as USPS does not update the USCIS records automatically or forward the mail sent by the immigration agency. “Changing your address with the US Postal Service (USPS) will not change your address with USCIS and USPS will not forward your mail from USCIS,” the agency said on its website.As per the warning the applicants who fail to update their address with USCIS could miss out on the important notices, immigration documents or other benefit-related correspondence. USCIS also recommends updating the address information with both immigration agency and postal service.Online filing encouragedUSCIS strongly encourages people to submit address changes through a USCIS online account as soon as they move. The agency says updating online satisfies the legal notification requirement, lets it process the change almost immediately, and removes the need to mail a paper Form AR-11, Alien’s Change of Address Card.People can use the self-service tool in their online account even if they originally filed their case by mail. Those with pending cases must enter the receipt number for each pending benefit request so the new address is applied correctly. Filing the paper Form AR-11 by mail also meets the legal requirement.USPS change is not enoughThe agency warns that changing an address with the U.S. Postal Service does not update it with USCIS, and USPS will not forward mail from USCIS. People must update both. USCIS recommends using the USPS ZIP Code lookup tool to enter a full address in the standard format.Special cases* Sponsors who are U.S. citizens, nationals or lawful permanent residents and have filed an affidavit of support must submit Form I-865 within 30 days of moving.* Citizens with pending or approved orphan or Hague adoption cases must treat a move as a significant household change and follow separate reporting procedures. articles.title: Six Flags shuts down two Canada’s Wonderland roller coasters after Georgia death
articles.summary: 'The safety of our guests and team members remains one of our highest priorities'
articles.body:
See more Toronto Sun on Google — save as a Preferred Source

Two of Canada's Wonderland's most popular roller coasters were shut down following a fatal accident at a ride in a Georgia theme park.

A man died at Six Flags Over Georgia after falling off Goliath, a 200-foot-tall roller coaster, on Monday. Four others were also injured.

The man was reportedly thrown from his seat, fell, and hit the ride multiple times before he died in front of horrified witnesses.

The park was evacuated after the tragic incident.

Similar attractions to Goliath have been temporarily closed "out of an abundance of caution" at other Six Flags parks, including Canada's Wonderland's Behemoth and Leviathan, a company spokesperson said in a statement to the Toronto Sun .

"The safety of our guests and team members remains one of our highest priorities," they added.

Goliath, manufactured by Bollinger and Mabillard, is classified as a "hypercoaster," meaning a roller coaster that stands at 200 feet to 300 feet tall. It has a 196-foot drop and reaches speeds of up to 112 km/h.

Canada's Wonderland's Behemoth, which is manufactured by the same company, is slightly larger and faster, standing at 230 feet tall and reaching speeds of up to 123 km/h.

"We are deeply saddened by the guest incident at our park today," they added, noting that the Six Flags Entertainment Corporation is providing support to guests and staff who were impacted, and the park is cooperating with the investigation by local authorities.

Canada's Wonderland was open on Thanksgiving, but as of Monday afternoon, visitors were unable to ride either Behemoth or Leviathan.

It is unknown when the two roller coasters and other rides at Six Flags parks will reopen.

Along with Canada's Wonderland and Six Flags Over Georgia, Six Flags Entertainment Corporation operates nine other major theme parks across North America, including Darien Lake, Cedar Point and Kings Island.

The Vaughan amusement park is open from Thursdays to Sundays for the remainder of October, notably for its Halloween-themed evenings and weekends.

It will remain open on weekends and during the holidays for Winterfest before shutting down and reopening in the spring.

The cause of Monday's incident is not yet known.

The death on Monday marks the seventh at the Georgia park, including one where a rider suffered an apparent heart attack on Goliath in 2006 — the year the ride opened.

In August, a roller coaster ride at a Six Flags Magic Mountain in California was linked to two deaths and numerous other serious injuries reported by riders over the past two decades.

articles.title: Centre asks states to go into ‘mission mode’ to curb stubble burning as farm fires rise in MP, Rajasthan
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Centre on Tuesday asked Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana and Delhi-NCR authorities to work in “mission mode” to prevent stubble
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Centre on Tuesday asked Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana and Delhi-NCR authorities to work in “mission mode” to prevent stubble burning ahead of the peak crop residue burning season, flagging a sharp rise in farm fires in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan.Union agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan and environment minister Bhupender Yadav chaired a high-level inter-ministerial meeting with state agriculture ministers and officials to review crop residue management and measures to control farm fires.“Very little time remains between the harvesting of the current crop and the sowing of the rabi crop. Therefore, the administrative machinery must step away from paperwork and work directly on the ground on a war footing,” the two ministers said, according to a statement from the agriculture ministry.States have been directed to hold immediate meetings with district magistrates to ensure strict monitoring and implement practical solutions, the ministry said.Farm fires surge in Madhya Pradesh, RajasthanReviewing data from September 15 to October 12, Chouhan noted that stubble-burning incidents had declined by 53.3% in Haryana and around 32% in Uttar Pradesh compared with the corresponding period last year. Punjab had also recorded a fall.However, the rise in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan prompted concern. Madhya Pradesh's farm-fire count increased from 55 to 277, a jump of 452%, while Rajasthan's tally rose from 20 to 60, an increase of 200%.Chouhan directed the two states to identify affected districts and villages and immediately prepare special action plans. He also cautioned states reporting fewer incidents against becoming complacent, as a substantial portion of the harvest was still pending.The latest figures reflect the uneven spread of farm fires across northern and central India.Madhya Pradesh recorded 277 incidents by October 11, followed by Uttar Pradesh with 121 and Punjab with 118. Rajasthan reported 45 cases, Haryana seven, Uttarakhand three and Delhi one, taking the total across the seven states to 572.Stubble burning had been detected in 87 districts by October 11, with Amritsar recording 60 incidents, the highest among the seven states covered.Farmers need affordable alternatives, says CentreChouhan said farmers had only 20-25 days between paddy harvesting and wheat sowing, making burning a quick and inexpensive way to clear fields despite its impact on soil nutrients, soil organisms and air quality in Delhi-NCR.“Simply telling farmers not to burn stubble is insufficient; we must provide them with easy, accessible and affordable alternatives,” he said.He said crop residue could be incorporated into the soil to serve as organic manure or removed for use in bio-CNG, bio-ethanol, electricity generation and fodder production.The government also aims to develop a system in which farmers can benefit from environmentally friendly practices, including through carbon credits.Chouhan urged states to promote short-duration crop varieties, including Pusa 2090 and PR126, instead of longer-duration varieties such as Pusa-44, to give farmers sufficient time to clear fields before the next sowing season.Centre flags idle crop residue machinesThe Centre has supplied more than 3.54 lakh crop residue management machines to states, including 26,109 during the current financial year. However, a central survey found that around 40% of older machines in Punjab and 48% in Haryana were idle or non-functional, news agency PTI reported.Chouhan directed states to repair existing machines alongside distributing new ones. He also called for the activation of Custom Hiring Centres to ensure that small and marginal farmers could access machinery at affordable rates.Between 2018-19 and 2025-26, the Centre released Rs 4,266.47 crore to states under the Crop Residue Management scheme. Punjab received Rs 2,056.50 crore, Haryana Rs 1,171.71 crore, Uttar Pradesh Rs 868.67 crore and Madhya Pradesh Rs 59 crore.For 2026-27, Rs 592.57 crore has been allocated, of which Rs 430.87 crore has been released.Chouhan expressed concern over slow utilisation of funds and urged Punjab to submit utilisation certificates for earlier releases so that the next instalment could be cleared without delay.Monitoring to intensify after 3 pmYadav called for stronger enforcement and ground-level monitoring, identifying key districts in Punjab and Haryana for closer scrutiny.In Punjab, these include Sangrur, Tarn Taran, Amritsar, Patiala and Gurdaspur. In Haryana, the focus districts are Kaithal, Karnal, Kurukshetra, Ambala and Fatehabad.He stressed the need to integrate stubble-burning data with the Commission for Air Quality Management and the Central Pollution Control Board, while tracking harvesting schedules and weather conditions that affect air quality in the National Capital Region.Yadav said monitoring should not rely on satellite data alone. District collectors should conduct ground assessments, while enforcement measures should include patrolling and flying squads, particularly after 3 pm, when satellites do not pass over the region.Chouhan also called for direct supply chains connecting farmers with thermal power plants that use stubble pellets for co-firing, compressed bio-gas plants and second-generation bio-ethanol facilities. He urged states to implement approved supply projects without delay and asked drought-hit regions to store crop residue safely for use as livestock fodder.The ministers said state governments would remain responsible for implementation, with the Centre providing technical, administrative and financial support.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: ‘Peace through strength’: Trump Gaza plan gains global backing one year on
articles.summary: Donald Trump's Board of Peace excludes UNRWA from Gaza's future as the EU pledges $1 billion and demilitarization efforts gain global momentum.
articles.body: A year has passed since President Donald Trump made history by brokering a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas, setting in motion an ambitious peace plan aimed at bringing lasting stability to the region. In the days and months since the ceasefire and Trump’s 20-point peace plan took hold, progress has drawn support from across the globe — including from unexpected quarters. Senior advisor to the Board of Peace Josh Gruenbaum told Fox News Digital that the success of the last 12 months was largely attributable to President Donald Trump’s leadership and commitment to seeking peace. TRUMP-BACKED BOARD OF PEACE, ISRAEL 'WILL TAKE ACTION' IF HAMAS REMAINS OUT OF COMPLIANCE: NETANYAHU ADVISOR "The unlock was somebody who came in, who really knew the file because they had the chance to study it and understand it," Gruenbaum said. Trump and his team, including U.S. special envoy to the Middle East Steve Witkoff, U.S. special envoy for Peace Jared Kushner and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, "created working relationships with regional actors with trust, overlaid with peace through strength," while also forcing Hamas to finally understand that "this was either going to end the very hard way for them, or there was an off-ramp and a way to do this in a more dignified way, which is what the 20-point plan was." He said this has been achieved by "building consensus through the world, including through Europe, that this is the only game in town. This is the only pragmatic approach to make this thing stop." A particular point of strength for the Board of Peace, Gruenbaum added, has been "cultivating really strong relationships with the United Nations." In November 2025, the United Nations endorsed the Board of Peace through Resolution 2803. European Union Commissioner for the Mediterranean and for Demography Dubravka Šuica announced at a high-level briefing at the Board of Peace in September that the European Union had "gathered about $1 billion for early recovery in Gaza," and would sign recovery projects with the UNDP and UNICEF. "We are doing this in alignment with the priorities of the Board of Peace and the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG)," Šuica stated. US URGES DONORS TO ABANDON UNRWA FUNDING AS UN DEFENDS AGENCY'S MISSION The International Stabilization Force, which will train a future police force in Gaza and oversee demilitarization, has received commitments from Kazakhstan, Morocco, Albania and Kosovo, with other countries said to be in the pipeline for admission. Notably absent from Gaza’s future, per the Board of Peace plan, is the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA). The Board of Peace has been unequivocal that UNRWA will have no involvement in Gaza. One U.S. agency, the USAID Office of the Inspector General, is currently investigating over 1,500 UNRWA employees for involvement in terror groups. On X, the Board of Peace recently stated that it "will only work with trusted partners who deliver for the people of Gaza and contribute to a deradicalized Strip," and emphasized that "UNRWA fails on those litmus tests." The Board of Peace’s effort has support from unlikely corners. Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton wrote in a June editorial in the Financial Times that while the plan was "not the one many of us would have drafted," she believes "it remains the only framework backed by sufficient leverage, political engagement and potential resources to move parties towards implementation." The Board of Peace has received about $18 billion in pledges for reconstruction, the BBC recently reported. A Board of Peace official told Fox News Digital that next steps in the reconstruction program include a six-month program with 66 recovery initiatives, including rubble clearance, unexploded ordnance clearance, construction of temporary housing and destroying tunnel infrastructure. The initiatives are expected to cost $2.45 billion, and tenders for some projects have been submitted. KUSHNER GIVES HAMAS STARK ULTIMATUM: DISARM OR ISRAEL GETS US BACKING TO ‘FINISH THE JOB’ In the year ahead, the Board of Peace must clear a number of hurdles, including a full demilitarization and de-radicalization of Hamas in Gaza. Gruenbaum says that the Board of Peace is "realistic and sober" but is also "in a historic place with Hamas," having secured verbal agreements and offering a path to amnesty for those who qualify. Gruenbaum also says that the 20-point plan is Hamas’ best path forward and that regional dynamics leave them with few remaining options. Mediators are increasingly supporting the Board of Peace, Tehran is focused on its current war, and Israel is continuing to apply pressure, though Gruenbaum says the Board of Peace continues to stress that they must comply with the ceasefire. Gruenbaum said that deradicalization will never be a top-down process led by the U.S., but will be managed through the NCAG. He said that the NCAG’s members "have kids that have been brought up" under the current UNRWA-run system, so "they understand the situation." The approach will involve the new technocratic government, whose members have extensive experience in civil service, taking the lead on "vetting teachers" and "vetting people who are involved in civil governance." Gruenbaum celebrated the potential of bringing together the NCAG and Israeli authorities through the transformation of Gaza. "This is a monumental opportunity for the Palestinian people of Gaza where their governing body is going to be uniquely focused on delivering services for its constituents and if we could create this amazing relationship where we build trust between Israel and the NCAG, we deliver on both sides of the equation – security for Israel and freedom and a better life, self-determination and prosperity-building inside of Gaza. That’s a two-way trust-building system." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Gruenbaum added that the successes in Gaza could lead to successes elsewhere. "Maybe these best practices get learned by the Palestinian Authority. Maybe Israel starts adding more trust with different people in the system. I think this is a huge moment in the history of the Middle East."

articles.title: In 2014, Australia tested geopolymer concrete in ten 50-metre pours beside Wellcamp Airport’s runway; after the trial met specifications, it was approved for heavy aircraft pavement
articles.summary: Discover how geopolymer concrete was successfully tested and implemented at Wellcamp Airport for heavy-duty aircraft pavement, reducing carbon emissions and paving the way for sustainable construction practices.
articles.body: In 2014, Queensland, Australia, engineers tested a specially developed geopolymer concrete mix before incorporating it for heavy-duty aircraft pavement at Brisbane West Wellcamp Airport. This trial involved 10 individual pours, each one five metres wide and 50 metres long, on a private hangar pavement outside the airport boundary, east of the runway. The aim was to establish whether the material could meet the project’s specified performance requirements and be placed using a slip-form paving machine. After a successful experimental phase, the concrete mix and construction method were approved for the Wellcamp project. Subsequently, the airport became a major commercial-scale application of geopolymer concrete, with around 40,000 cubic metres used across the wide construction project.Why engineers decided to test geopolymer concreteConventional concrete generally uses Portland cement as its principal binding ingredient. Cement production involves high-temperature processing and releases carbon dioxide, thus making it a significant source of industrial emissions. Geopolymer concrete provides an alternative binder system that uses chemically activated aluminosilicate materials. Based on the formulation, these can include industrial by-products like fly ash and ground granulated blast-furnace slag. The environmental benefits vary with the ingredients, chemical activators, manufacturing process and transport requirements, so they cannot be assumed to be identical across all geopolymer products.For Wellcamp Airport, geopolymer concrete, known as Earth Friendly Concrete (EFC), was supplied by Australian construction company Wagners. Pavements capable of withstanding the substantial loads and stresses associated with aircraft movement, especially in turning areas, taxiways, and apron surfaces, were required for this project. Therefore, engineers needed to assess not only the material’s strength and shrinkage but also whether it could be transported, placed and compacted reliably using the proposed method of construction. The trial was designed to test the specific EFC mix and paving process intended for the project.10 pours tested the mix and construction methodBetween May and July, the trial took place on a private hangar pavement outside the airport boundary. This pavement allowed engineers and contractors to assess the mix under construction conditions before proceeding with the main airport pavement works.Prepared by consulting engineers ACG, the project specification set two crucial performance criteria: an average flexural strength of 4.8 megapascals at 28 days and a maximum drying shrinkage of 450 microstrain at 28 days, as noted in the project’s paper. Flexural strength measures concrete’s ability to withstand bending stresses, which are relevant to rigid pavement under heavy loads. Furthermore, shrinkage is considered important because excessive contraction can contribute to cracking.In addition to this, the trial examined the practical challenges of producing, delivering and placing EFC. The material needed to retain suitable workability during transport and remain compatible with the slip-form paving equipment. According to the project paper, the trial phase helped resolve construction challenges, following which the mix and paving method were approved for use on the airport project.From trial pavement to heavy-duty aircraft surfacesAfter the successful testing, construction moved to the airport’s main pavement areas. During August and September 2014, work on the aircraft turning node took place. This was followed by apron construction from October into early November. The project used heavy-duty EFC pavement approximately 435 millimetres thick in the aircraft turning areas, with geopolymer concrete also used in the taxiway and apron pavement.The trial was only one part of a much larger construction effort. The project report indicates that about 40,000 cubic meters of geopolymer concrete were employed at the Wellcamp Airport, amounting to about 100,000 tonnes. The company identifies the airport as one of the notable projects which have seen the use of EFC, with an estimated reduction in carbon emissions of around 6,600 tonnes for the whole project. Wellcamp Airport began commercial operations in November 2014, with QantasLink operating its first commercial flights on November 17.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
articles.summary: Pope Leo had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican said.
articles.body:
Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican has said in a medical bulletin.

The 71-year-old underwent a 90 minute surgery on Tuesday at Rome's Gemelli Hospital and was subsequently diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma.

"After the operation, the Pope awoke normally and returned after a brief period of observation to his room on the 10th floor," the Vatican said in a statement.

The lump was first detected during what the Vatican has described as "routine checks".

Earlier, large crowds gathered outside the hospital to greet the Pope, with some waiting for several hours.

They cheered greetings and well wishes as he passed, while he waved and smiled back through the lowered back window of his car.

He was then met by staff on the hospital steps. "I'm sorry," one of them commiserated, to which the Pope gave a smile and a shrug. "We're here for you," he was assured.

In its statement, the Vatican said the whole lower lobe of the Pope's right lung was removed "to ensure the procedure was radical".

A Vatican source told Agence France-Presse news agency further tests were being carried out to see if there was any sign the cancer had spread.

It was Leo XIV himself who on Sunday announced news of his operation to the world, speaking from the balcony in St Peter's Square after delivering the traditional Angelus blessing.

He said the nodule, or growth, on his lung was "contained" and had been found "at a very early stage", but that doctors had advised him to have it removed.

Gemelli's thoracic surgery team operated on the Pope, whose schedule has already been cleared until 20 October to give him time to recover.

Nodules are quite common and not necessarily cancerous, but after it was examined the medical team confirmed it was pulmonary adenocarcinoma, "as suspected by pre-operative tests", the Vatican said.

The Vatican has stressed that the pontiff, who is generally thought to be fit, had no symptoms of infection or illness.

Cardinal Kikuchi Tarcisio Isao of Tokyo wrote on social media that he'd had an audience with Pope Leo on Monday, and said the pontiff felt "nothing wrong" physically.

He said the Pope had decided to check in for surgery as soon as possible because he was due to travel to Latin America in early November, and was keen to stick to that plan.

The trip is particularly significant because it includes a visit to Peru, where the pontiff was a missionary and then a Bishop for many years.

Despite all the reassurances, the news has shaken Catholics all over the world.

"Am I worried? Yes, because I certainly wasn't expecting anything like this," Vatican Secretary of State Cardinal Parolin told journalists on Tuesday.

He agreed that the news was like a "bolt from the blue", but said the cardinals had been struck by the Pope's "serenity" and were confident in his recovery.

Outside Gemelli Hospital, which has treated several popes and is home to a large statue of John Paul II, a few Catholics lingered after the pontiff was admitted.

Carla had come specially, wanting to be close.

"He seems calm, so we are calm too - even though illness is always unpleasant," she told the BBC. "We will wait here and pray."

"I was in St Peter's Square when he made the announcement, and I felt really awful," said Elsa, who was also present. "I was really taken aback," she said, explaining that when Pope Leo was elected she had thought he was a younger, healthier pontiff.

"It turns out he's vulnerable too," she added.

articles.title: Police officer tells rape trial he did not commit sex crimes
articles.summary: Carmichael John Williamson, 32, from Shetland, has given evidence in his trial at the High Court in Edinburgh.
articles.body:
A police officer accused of rape in Shetland has told a court he did not commit the crimes he is accused of.

Carmichael John Williamson - known as John Williamson - is on trial at the High Court in Edinburgh.

He is accused of assaulting and raping a teenage girl in 2014 and 2015, and of having sexual activity with the girl when she was under age. It is also alleged he raped a woman in 2022 while she was intoxicated and unable to consent.

Giving evidence, Williamson, 32, told the second day of the trial it was untrue that he had penetrative sex with the girl when she was an under-age teenager.

More stories from North East Scotland, Orkney and Shetland

Listen to news from North East Scotland on BBC Sounds

After the Crown case closed, Williamson took the stand.

He said it was not true that he took part in sexual activity with an adult woman outside a community hall during a function in 2022.

Defence counsel David Nicolson KC asked Williamson if there was any sexual contact between him and the female at the venue.

He also denied that there was any further sexual contact with the woman later on at a house.

Asked about the teenager, he said that she made contact through Snapchat when he himself was a teenage student.

He said the earliest point he could remember engaging in sexual intercourse was the day after her 16th birthday.

Asked if the relationship was sexual when she was 15, he replied: "That's not true."

He said he had no recollection of ever recording any of their sexual encounters.

Under cross examination by the Crown, he disputed that the women were telling the truth.

He told the court he has been a police constable for more than 10 years and was previously a special constable, but was currently suspended.

Williamson, of Burra, denies the series of charges alleged to have been committed at locations in Shetland between 2014 and 2022.

The trial, before judge John Morris KC, continues.

articles.title: US Supreme Court backs Trump administration in fight over records on Elon Musk’s DOGE
articles.summary: The US Supreme Court has agreed to hear the Trump administration’s challenge to a lawsuit seeking public records about trillionaire Elon Musk’s Department
articles.body: The US Supreme Court has agreed to hear the Trump administration’s challenge to a lawsuit seeking public records about trillionaire Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).The move has reopened a legal battle over whether the US government initiative is subject to federal transparency laws.The case was brought by Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington (CREW), which argues that DOGE should be treated as a federal agency and made subject to the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA). The watchdog is seeking records of DOGE’s activities during the early months of US president Donald Trump’s second term.The Trump administration maintains that DOGE is a presidential advisory body and is therefore exempt from FOIA requirements. Its lawyers argue that allowing the lawsuit to proceed would undermine the “autonomy and confidentiality” of presidential advisers.The administration has also challenged an appeals court ruling that permitted the plaintiffs to seek a sworn deposition from DOGE acting administrator Amy Gleason.The Supreme Court is intervening for the second time in the dispute. In June 2025, its conservative majority narrowed a lower court order requiring the government to produce DOGE-related records, finding that US District Judge Christopher Cooper had ruled too broadly.However, according to news agency AP, Cooper had ruled in CREW’s favour by ordering expedited processing of its records request, and an appeals court panel also sided with the watchdog. CREW maintains that the panel complied with the Supreme Court’s earlier directions.The group argues that the public has a right to understand how DOGE helped the Trump administration carry out a sweeping overhaul of federal government operations in 2025. Its lawyers said public statements by Trump and other undisputed facts indicated that DOGE exercised substantial independent authority across the government.In a statement on Tuesday, CREW attorney Nikhel Sus said lower courts had consistently found that the group was entitled to records that could help establish whether DOGE’s authority made it subject to FOIA.“We will continue to pursue transparency for the American people, who deserve to know the details of the Trump Administration's efforts to unilaterally remake the federal government,” Sus said, according to AP.You use AI every day. articles.title: In 2019, a Nevada farmer used solar panels to irrigate 500 acres of alfalfa alongside diesel generators, saving 16,385 gallons of diesel and projecting $1 million in lifetime savings
articles.summary: In 2019, a Nevada farmer transformed his 500-acre alfalfa farm by integrating solar-powered irrigation, resulting in significant diesel savings and projected lifetime cost reductions of $1 million. Discover how hybrid systems enable sustainable farming in off-grid locations.
articles.body: An alfalfa farmer reduced the use of diesel by 16,385 gallons in 2019 after installing solar-powered irrigation at his off-grid farm. The Railroad Valley Farms in Nye County, Nevada, paired solar photovoltaic (PV) arrays with diesel generators for the irrigation of 500 acres of alfalfa, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA). Mark Dunn, the farm's operator, believes that this hybrid setup will save about $1 million over its lifetime.The farm sits at roughly 4,900 feet above sea level, where the area only receives five to six inches of annual precipitation. Alfalfa production depends on groundwater and powered irrigation, but no electrical grid was connected to the farm; instead, it relied on diesel to pump water and operate its irrigation systems.Why the farm used both solar and diesel A viable alternative was available through Solar power; however, it couldn't meet the required round-the-clock irrigation since it couldn't function beyond daylight hours. In response, Dunn adopted a hybrid arrangement in which solar provided most of the energy demand and the diesel generators functioned as automatic backup in case the output were to fall short.According to Ag Proud, the first installation used variable-speed drives and solar arrays to track the sun and power four quarter-mile centre pivots that irrigated 500 acres of alfalfa. With calculated spacing between them, the panels were arranged in a way to prevent one from shading the other while two 325-kilowatt direct-current arrays supplied 175-kilowatt alternating-current systems.Dunn used solar modelling to estimate electricity generation and the available hours for pumping before committing to the project. He had also planned to irrigate whenever sunlight and temperatures allowed, while storing water in the soil for crop use. The output of solar energy was contingent on weather and temperature, as higher temperatures reduced panel performance whereas cloud cover lowered solar generation, consequently increasing the need for diesel backup. Dunn reports that from around October to mid-May, the system functioned mainly on solar, with the diesel generators supplementing the system during summer.Fuel savings and the limits of the modelAccording to the USDA, the project received a $253,405 grant through the Rural Energy for America Program. During its first full year of operation, it achieved 223,400 kilowatt-hours in solar mode and saved 16,385 gallons of diesel. Since the solar irrigation system became operational in late April 2019, Dunn told Ag Proud, it had missed the opportunity to use its harnessed power for pre-irrigation during the preceding winter. This delayed start thereby limited the system’s contribution and left the farm dependent on its existing diesel-powered equipment.In its first year, the solar system reduced the requirement for diesel by 60%, and the model’s performance suggested 70% savings could be realised, a figure that Dunn believes could go up to 75% under the right conditions. However, these estimates were only projections, not a verified number.Solar remained financially feasible when compared to diesel, which cost $2.15 per gallon in October 2019 before rising to between $2.30 and $2.40, and Dunn cautioned that the economics may vary from one farm to another. For operations with substantial energy demand throughout the year, it would be more beneficial than for farms at high altitudes with short growing seasons. In the end, the project proved that solar power can reduce diesel dependence where grid electricity is unavailable, but it did not eliminate the need for fuel.You use AI every day.
